related.title: FANUC ROBODRILL 鑽銑平台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付偏置幾何圖與四姿態殘差表。；教學 e≤0.020 mm，原案失敗、改良通過；另需保留未參與擬合的姿態驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver offset geometry and four-pose residuals.; At teaching e≤0.020 mm the original fails and improved case passes; validate with held-out poses.
related.difference: 建立孔加工離線時間估算，避免忽略換刀與定位。
related.differenceEn: Build an offline hole-processing estimate including tool change and positioning.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 中心偏置 r 在轉角 θ 下造成差異弦長 e=2r sin(θ/2)。；教學偏置 r=0.020 mm，轉角 θ=90°。；e=2×0.020×sin45°=0.028284 mm。
軸向速度 vf=fn；時間 t=60L/(fn)，再加輔助時間。；純教學幾何 L=20 mm，f=0.10 mm/rev，n=1000 rev/min，輔助 5 s。；t=60×20/(0.10×1000)+5=17 s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A center offset r creates a differential chord e=2r sin(θ/2) over rotation θ.; Teaching offset r=0.020 mm and rotation θ=90°.; e=2×0.020×sin45°=0.028284 mm.
Axial feed speed is vf=fn; t=60L/(fn), plus auxiliary time.; Offline teaching values: L=20 mm, f=0.10 mm/rev, n=1000 rev/min and 5 s auxiliary time.; t=60×20/(0.10×1000)+5=17 s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 五軸工具機運動學校準
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付偏置幾何圖與四姿態殘差表。；教學 e≤0.020 mm，原案失敗、改良通過；另需保留未參與擬合的姿態驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver offset geometry and four-pose residuals.; At teaching e≤0.020 mm the original fails and improved case passes; validate with held-out poses.
related.difference: 由旋轉軸角度誤差推算遠端位置誤差，理解阿貝偏置。
related.differenceEn: Convert rotary angular error into remote position error and understand Abbe offset.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 中心偏置 r 在轉角 θ 下造成差異弦長 e=2r sin(θ/2)。；教學偏置 r=0.020 mm，轉角 θ=90°。；e=2×0.020×sin45°=0.028284 mm。
橫向誤差 e=L sinδθ，小角度可近似 Lδθ，但 δθ 必須用弧度。；教學 L=200 mm，δθ=0.010°。；e=200 sin(0.010°)=0.0349066 mm；弧度近似為 200×0.000174533。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A center offset r creates a differential chord e=2r sin(θ/2) over rotation θ.; Teaching offset r=0.020 mm and rotation θ=90°.; e=2×0.020×sin45°=0.028284 mm.
Transverse error e=L sinδθ≈Lδθ for small angles, with δθ in radians.; Teaching L=200 mm and δθ=0.010°.; e=200 sin(0.010°)=0.0349066 mm; the radian approximation is 200×0.000174533.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
